text: Duplex mismatch throughput gets WORSE as offered load increases. Why is that diagnostic?
choices: Most performance problems degrade gracefully under load; this one collapses, which is the opposite and is characteristic
explanation: The full-duplex end transmits whenever it likes; the half-duplex end interprets simultaneous transmission as a collision and backs off. Under light load it is nearly invisible. The counter fingerprint is late collisions on the half-duplex end.
